Home.title: The sky is not the limit.
Home.description: Cross the great portal, choose one of eight paths, and write a journey capable of transforming your own crest.
Home.charactersDescription: Choose a class and follow every material earned on the same crest, from the first calling to the legendary Miriamite.
Home.newsImageAlt: Adventurers gathered before the portal of a Miraj citadel
Home.news1Title: The Hall of Eight gains complete progression through level 110.
Home.news1Description: Classes, levels, and prestige materials now tell one visual story, from Bronze to Miriamite.
Home.news2Title: Realms prepare for clans, wars, and territories.
Home.news2Description: Discover the planned structure for conflicts that will move alliances across the map.
Home.news3Title: Portal, launcher, and Lobby form one passage.
Home.news3Description: The reconstruction brings accounts, characters, updates, and game entry together in one continuous journey.

Game.title: A world rebuilt to live again.
Game.description: Miraj of Icarus is a fantasy MMORPG under reconstruction. Its identity, maps, and world mechanics are preserved while its technical foundation is replaced with original code.
Game.proposalTitle: Choose a path, build a legacy, and cross the realms together.
Game.pillar1Text: Maps, cities, NPCs, creatures, quests, and portals form a shared realm that will continue growing alongside its players.
Game.pillar2Text: Each class offers its own combat pace, group role, and visual identity, recorded in a crest that evolves with the character.
Game.pillar3Text: Mounts, fellows, and suspended regions remain part of the preserved identity while the client and servers are rebuilt with original technology.
Game.imageAlt: The Miraj citadel above the clouds
Game.reconstructionTitle: Every system returns as part of a complete journey.
Game.accessText: Account, secure session, launcher, and server selection already form one integrated journey.
Game.charactersText: Creation, four slots, classes, level, and a safe deletion cycle share the same contracts between portal and Lobby.
Game.worldText: Movement, combat, NPCs, visibility, and instances belong to the next cycle of the original World Server.
Game.firstStepTitle: The path begins with a character.
Game.firstStepText: Meet the eight classes, choose your pace, and follow the crest's evolution from the first level to Miriamite.

Realms.title: Every realm holds a conflict.
Realms.description: Realms are independent game worlds. Characters grow, clans raise their banners, and future wars may redraw control of their territories.
Realms.availableTitle: Choose where your story will be written.
Realms.empty: No realm could be reached right now. Try again in a few moments.
Realms.systemsTitle: A frontier shaped by its players.
Realms.systemsText: Clans, wars, and territories are still in development. This is the planned direction for turning every realm into a shared story.
Realms.clansDescription: Players will be able to gather allies, organize roles, and build an identity recognized across the realm.
Realms.warsDescription: Planned conflicts will set clans against one another through clear objectives, seasons, and shared recognition.
Realms.territoriesDescription: Conquerable regions are planned to record control, open strategic routes, and reshape relations between clans.

Community.title: The forum is still being built.
Community.description: This will be the meeting place for players, clans, and the development team. The doors will open when the structure is ready to welcome the community.
Community.doorsTitle: A place to share the journey.
Community.guidesDescription: Discoveries, builds, and paths written by those who cross the realms.
Community.clansDescription: Recruitment, banner showcases, and organization among allies.
Community.developmentDescription: Project updates, testing, and a place for player reports.
Community.notice: There is no separate registration, external address, or opening date for the forum yet. Official information will be published here.

Classes.following: What is it like to follow this path?
Classes.finalCrest: The crest has reached its definitive legendary form.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.epithet: The blade that opens the way
warrior.summary: Advances without hesitation and turns constant pressure into space for allies.
warrior.calling: For those who prefer to lead every charge and sustain combat through strength.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.summary: Controls the field, protects the group, and stands firm when the realm demands resilience.
guardian.calling: For those who find their strength in protecting fellow travelers.

thief.name: Thief
thief.summary: Exploits openings, changes position quickly, and decides the fight with precision.
thief.calling: For those who like to observe, close in, and act at exactly the right moment.

priest.name: Priest
priest.epithet: The light that sustains the journey
priest.summary: Channels protection and restoration to support companions through the hardest crossings.
priest.calling: For those who watch the entire field and turn care into victory.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.summary: Focuses arcane energy and controls areas of battle through preparation and magical power.
wizard.calling: For those who prefer to understand the fight before unleashing their full power.

archer.name: Archer
archer.summary: Keeps distance, chooses targets, and combines movement with precise attacks.
archer.calling: For those who want freedom of movement and command over every shot.

idoll.name: Idol
idoll.epithet: A presence that transforms the field
idoll.summary: Channels energy through charm and presence, strengthening harmony among allies.
idoll.calling: For those who want to influence the whole battle and raise the group's potential.

magician.name: Magician
magician.summary: Manipulates crystals and magical devices in an unpredictable style distinct from the Wizard's arcane tradition.
magician.calling: For those who enjoy unexpected solutions and changing the pace of a fight.

bronze.name: Bronze
bronze.description: The calling takes shape, and the first crest recognizes the chosen path.

silver.name: Silver
silver.description: Technique and consistency begin to appear in the metal of the insignia.

gold.name: Gold
gold.description: The character leaves a first permanent mark upon the realms.

platinum.name: Platinum
platinum.description: Experience refines the crest into a cold, precise shine.

topaz.name: Topaz
topaz.description: The traveler's will begins to radiate heat through the insignia.

amethyst.name: Amethyst
amethyst.description: The crest records a deeper connection to the energy of the realms.

obsidian.name: Obsidian
obsidian.description: Dark and polished, the symbol carries the strength of one who did not yield.

jade.name: Jade
jade.description: The mineral reveals balance, experience, and control.

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby.description: Deep red records deeds that have already crossed the realms.

fernandium.name: Fernandium
fernandium.description: A rare arcane metal reserved for names that became history.

miriamite.name: Miriamite
miriamite.description: The legendary mineral transforms the entire journey into light, memory, and permanence.
